fields.Accepted Exams: 2026–27 priority: CAT 2025, then CMAT 2026 if seats remain, then GGSIPU CET 2026 after those merits are exhausted. CUET is a later vacancy route under the university’s notices.
fields.CAT / Exam Cutoff:
MBA [NCR-033]: 2026–27 CAT-route counselling, Round 3 (3 August 2026), closing merit ranks: Delhi General 304; Outside Delhi General 188. These are GGSIPU allotment ranks, not CAT percentiles; category and shift apply.

MBA (Analytics) [NCR-191]: 2026–27 CAT-route counselling, Round 3 (3 August 2026), closing merit ranks: Delhi General 517; Outside Delhi General 273. These are GGSIPU allotment ranks, not CAT percentiles; category and shift apply.

MBA (Financial Analysis) [NCR-192]: 2026–27 CAT-route counselling, Round 3 (3 August 2026), closing merit ranks: Delhi General 515; Outside Delhi General 298. These are GGSIPU allotment ranks, not CAT percentiles; category and shift apply.
fields.Eligibility:
MBA [NCR-033] / MBA (Analytics) [NCR-191]: Recognised bachelor’s degree of at least three years in any discipline with at least 50% aggregate; alternatively, a qualifying Engineering/Technology degree or equivalent with at least 50%, or the specified CA/Cost and Works Accountants/Company Secretaries final examination. Official 2026–27 PG brochure, printed p. 31.

MBA (Financial Analysis) [NCR-192]: Graduate in any discipline with at least 50% marks and at least one course in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or Operations Research at graduation level. Official 2026–27 PG brochure, printed p. 32.
fields.Selection Process: Counselling on overall CAT 2025 percentile; CMAT 2026 only for seats remaining after CAT, then GGSIPU CET 2026 if seats still remain. CUET is used only after the prescribed NLT/CET merit is exhausted, under later university notices.
fields.Application / Vacancy Signal:
MBA [NCR-033]: Official Round 2 notice dated 16 July 2026 admits CAT 2025, CMAT 2026 and CET 2026 candidates in that priority. Later rounds/current vacancies require the university’s live schedule.
